cases.name: Sierra Paulina Carranza
cases.about: She was a fifth grade Honor Student attending Pleasant Valley Intermediate School. Her father said he remembers her as a lively, outgoing girl adored by her half-siblings. He said she would “play teacher” with the younger children, setting up a little classroom, giving them notebooks and homework and putting on puppet shows.
cases.narrative: She died as a result from injuries sustained in a fire he deliberately set.
